title: Velvety Sour Chinese Navy Beans Wonton Soup
description: A plant-based, date-night Chinese dish featuring dried white navy beans in a sour and fluffy wonton soup, made with mushimono-steam and plant-based-friendly ingredients.
instructions: In a large pot, combine the soaked and drained navy beans, vegetable broth, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
While the beans are cooking, prepare the wonton filling by sauteing the sliced mushrooms and grated ginger in a little sesame oil until the mushrooms are softened.
To assemble the wontons, lay a wonton wrapper on a clean surface and place a small spoonful of the mushroom filling in the center of the wrapper.
Dip your finger in a little water and run it along the edges of the wrapper, then fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
When the beans are tender, add the wontons to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Stir in the chopped scallions and serve the soup hot.
